evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Identity-level creed: equates unrehearsed rollback with no rollback at all — permanence language treating the rule as constitutive of what 'having a rollback' means.
Operational cadence set as settled and load-bearing — the speaker commits the org to a recurring schedule, the kind of ratification language that performs the settling.
Assigning ownership ratifies the decision — the speaker acts on the rollback-rehearsal regime by naming who carries it, treating the matter as settled and operational.

mints.name: UnrehearsedCapabilityIsNoCapability
mints.title: a capability we have not rehearsed is a capability we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the conviction here asserting that unrehearsed capability is no capability at all — treating rehearsal as constitutive of possession?
